project.name: Identity and Event Semantics
project.summary: Make object continuity and mutation exact across zones, replacements, triggers, and state-based actions so curated-card behavior remains correct under replay, search, and presentation.
project.definition: Make object continuity and mutation exact across zones, replacements, triggers, and state-based actions so curated-card behavior remains correct under replay, search, and presentation.

krs.text: A leave-and-reenter vertical slice changes object incarnation, rejects stale ObjectRef values, and supplies correct last-known information in positive and negative trace tests.
Damage, life change, destruction, counters, and zone movement use a proposed-event to replacement/prevention to commit pipeline for the curated replacement-effects slice.
Trigger collection and state-based actions reach a deterministic fixpoint, and public rules boundaries no longer expose ambiguous bare storage IDs where incarnation matters.

task.name: Make trigger and SBA stabilization explicit
task.description: Build on the incarnation/LKI and proposed-event seams to make post-commit trigger collection and state-based actions reach an explicit deterministic fixpoint before priority. Audit the touched public rules boundaries and replace ambiguous bare storage IDs where object incarnation matters. Add rule-cited traces for chained SBA-to-trigger-to-SBA behavior, simultaneous terminal conditions, multiple simultaneous SBAs, stale references, and deterministic seeded replay. Preserve the fixed action, observation, and presentation ABIs; do not broaden into layers, general card registration, or unrelated SBA families.

task.name: Route curated mutations through proposed events
task.description: After the ObjectRef/LKI slice is available, introduce a narrow typed proposed-event pipeline for the curated replacement-effects boundary: propose, collect/apply matching replacement or prevention effects deterministically, then commit damage, life change, destruction, counter changes, and zone movement. Route the touched mutation entry points through this pipeline without a flag-day engine rewrite. Prove positive, negative, and ordering behavior with trace tests, including damage prevention and ETB tapped/with-counters cases; preserve deterministic replay and the current training/presentation ABIs. Document unsupported CR 616 breadth and do not expand card coverage beyond driver cases.

task.name: Implement ObjectRef incarnation and LKI vertical slice
task.description: After the state-foundation seam is available, implement a narrow zone-change vertical slice with ObjectRef {entity, incarnation}, stale-reference rejection, and explicit last-known information. Exercise leave-and-reenter behavior with positive and negative trace tests on existing curated cards. Prohibit bare storage IDs only at the touched rules boundaries; do not attempt the proposed-event pipeline or migrate every mechanic in this Task. Preserve deterministic replay and the existing training ABI.
